english.note: Use this when the protrusion has a rounded, bulging, or arched shape rather than simply extending straight out.

examples.english: The middle of the cake seems to protrude like a little hill.
examples.traditional: 個蛋糕焗到中間拱出嚟，好似座小山咁。
